title: SocksDroid
meta_description: SOCKS5 client for Android 5.0+ using VpnService
full_description: SocksDroid is an app for connecting to SOCKS5 servers (a type of VPN). We don't run a public VPN service ourselves, instead, we give you the app and you bring your own VPN server. We use Android's VpnService to route traffic from your applications to the server that you specify.This is an updated version of the original SocksDroid by PeterCxy to support modern Android devices. Source code is available at https://github.com/bndeff/socksdroid
